"Vivvy, I promise to be with you through sickness and in health, through the nuclear developments I accidentally create with Bowen, the highly unethical bullets I tend to create, losing my mind literally when I'm up in the air with you, through lethal serial killer hunts, and all the other dangerous stuff I put you through. 

I vow to love you now, always, forever, and even after I probably should have died, but hey, we're working on that bit. Death do us part and all that, I promise to live a life with you that isn't outlasted by age, but burns with love and commitment.

I also promise that I will let you have as many ducks as you'd like in our house, hey we could even make a sanctuary on one of my islands in the Caribbean.

Vivvy, I promise to ***do the thing*** with you now and forever."
